name: upgrade_cables
summary: Swap cable pieces for heavy (default) or super heavy cable in place, piece for piece, as the coil's merge builds them; a whole network or chosen pieces. Dry run by default; confirm to swap.

help.text: Each piece's replacement is the first piece of the target coil whose cells and connection ends match the old piece exactly, at the old rotation or turned: straights, corners, junctions and long straights all map. Pieces at or above the target stay. Devices connect to any cable type.
help.keys: job_id, status, ready, problems [], pieces [], by_prefab [], kept_pieces [], swapped [], removed [], not_swapped [], refund [], preflight_summary, final_check, verification, gas_check, error.

report.text: pieces (reference_id, prefab_name, position, rotation_deg, target_prefab_name, target_rotation_deg, rotation_kept, cost, network_id; up to limit), by_prefab (count, cost_each, cost_total, refund_each, max_power_w_before and after), kept_pieces and unmatched_pieces with reasons, coils (needed, available, stacks), refund, networks (loads, weakest cable before and after, lowest fuse, device_count), devices next to or on the pieces (first 5), connectivity, problems and ready.

problems.summary: The problems a dry run can list.
problems.text: unmatched_pieces (no replacement; skip_unmatched leaves them), not_enough_coils, link_added, link_lost, connectivity_model_mismatch, mounted_device_turned, shape_model_mismatch, not_complete, rocket_internal, no_local_player, thing_not_found.

reference_id.description: A device or piece on the network.

network_id.description: A network, every piece of it: its id or a handle on it (see networks).

reference_ids.description: Pieces by reference id, up to 4096; or give network_id.

refund.description: Give back what deconstructing the old pieces would. Default true; false is refund_to none.

limit.description: Pieces listed per list; default 5. All are counted and checked.

job_id.description: Poll a confirmed run; give nothing else.
